Decision requested: approve the containment and the 8D draft 8D-I-20250609-001 for C-2025-0001, C-2025-0002, C-2025-0004, C-2025-0005. No case is closed, scrapped or charged by this desk.
title: Decision memo: contain the body_controls cluster for FORD F-150 2021
